sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r11/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 39; Internal Quality Checks row 39; neighbouring rows 29/43 for context), read in memory with openpyxl read_only
evidence: Reasoned through each floor case against the frozen task (skill ref quality-checks.md s39 says 'reason through'). (1) Blank page / unavailable app: test.sh:115-125 exits 0 with the pre-written zero record (test.sh:8,60) if neither /api/health nor / answers; a blank page that answers fails gates/render criterion hro_gate_render (judge.toml:36: 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient') -> score.py:41 gates_passed false -> reward 0 (score.py:48), scored suite skipped (test.sh:217-220). (2) Static mock / seed copy with a client-side fake login: could pass render, but gates/constraints hro_gate_shared (judge.toml:73) requires a UI-created job and candidate to be found by the Observer in a new independent browser context; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate' -> reward 0. Prompt constraints/prompt.md:9 forbids reload/same-context tabs as independence. (3) Refusing submission (refuses every action or replies with refusal text): job/candidate creation fails -> constraints gate 0 -> reward 0. Functional refusal rows each name a same-kind positive control (e.g. hro_job_open, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_anonymous 'A signed-in success of each is the control', prompt.md:13 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control'), so even past the gate a refuse-everything app cannot farm negative rows. (4) Keyword-stuffed / injection page: every prompt line 1 marks the submission untrusted and requires rendered behaviour, not text; gates require observed persisted creation, so stuffing earns nothing. (5) Each scored prompt repeats the in-dimension gate (functional prompt.md:11-13 'gives every binary criterion 0'; polish prompt.md:11-12 'binary0 throughout'; visual prompt.md:11-12 'minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'), so a visual/polish-only shell cannot score even if the scored suite somehow ran. (6) Floor arithmetic: scoring.toml:10-11 functional floor 0.05; functional weights sum 59.5 over 44 binary criteria (parsed with tomllib in memory). A thin app that only passes the gate (hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 = 1.0/59.5 = 0.017) is below the floor -> score.py:47-48 reward 0, so polish/visual cannot be farmed by a near-shell. NOT-EXERCISED caveat lines give binary0/Likert1 so tool failure never inflates. Off-origin/CDN is correctly not treated as a floor case (no same-origin requirement in any prompt). Risk=true because raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent': no blank/mock/seed-copy/stuffed/refusing app has actually been run through the configured judge, so the near-zero floor is established by source reasoning only, not measurement.
counterexample: Tried: a client-only app with a JS password check rendering seed data and saving new jobs to localStorage - passes render plausibly but fails constraints (independent context sees nothing). An in-memory server that persists only jobs/candidates passes gates but scores ~0.017 functional < 0.05 floor -> reward 0. Conforming-alternative check: a real app with different routes/layout is not penalised by the gates (prompts discover by intent, no same-origin, no named routes). No passing counterexample found.
